task.title: P6-022: Fix tw_merge dropping the focus-ring colour on five vendored primitives
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-022. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.

**`tw_merge` silently drops the focus-ring colour on five vendored primitives, not one** (rescoped 2026-07-30 — the entry filed it as an `Item` footnote). Root cause found upstream: `tw_merge-0.1.21/src/core/merge/get_collision_id.rs:617-627` — an arbitrary width like `ring-[3px]` fails the `parse::<usize>()` at `:619`, falls through to the `["ring", ..] => "ring-color"` arm at `:627`, and therefore collides with `ring-ring/50`; last one wins. The same pair sits in one `tw_merge` input at `item.rs:59`, `button.rs:71`, `checkbox.rs:27`, `toggle_group.rs:116` and `input_group.rs:25`. Not affected: `input.rs:81-87` and `count_stepper.rs:357`, which use `ring-2` and hit the width arm. Accessibility-visible, and it hits Button — so it is not cosmetic trivia. Consider a sibling upstream report to `tw_merge`.
